retrieval_note: Identifiers and titles verified against the International Safe Transit Association (https://ista.org) test series documentation on 2026-10-31. Standards are copyrighted; only non-copyrighted metadata is stored.
disclaimer: This registry stores only publicly available metadata (identifiers, titles, scope summaries in own words). No copyrighted standard test sequences or numeric thresholds are reproduced. Physical testing requires execution in an ISTA-certified laboratory. Software cannot certify or pass an ISTA physical test.

standards.title: Integrity Testing for Packaged-Products weighing 150 lb (68 kg) or Less
standards.scope_summary: Non-simulation integrity screening for individual packaged products weighing 150 lb (68 kg) or less when prepared for shipment. It is not designed to simulate environmental occurrences.
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: Standard baseline test for small and medium home appliances (fans, blenders, kettles, microwaves) shipped individually.
standards.notes_and_limitations: PHYSICAL_TEST requires laboratory execution (vibration table and drop tester). Software can only check weight eligibility and formulate the required test sequence.

standards.title: Integrity Testing for Packaged-Products weighing Over 150 lb (68 kg)
standards.scope_summary: Non-simulation integrity screening for an individual packaged product weighing over 150 lb (68 kg) when prepared for shipment. It is not designed to simulate environmental occurrences.
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: Applicable to large heavy appliances such as high-capacity commercial washers, heavy refrigeration, and bulk crated equipment.

standards.title: Packaged-Products weighing 150 lb (68 kg) or Less utilizing Random Vibration
standards.scope_summary: Non-simulation integrity screening for individual packaged products weighing 150 lb (68 kg) or less, utilizing random vibration.
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: Simulates road transit vibrations for consumer appliances in corrugated cartons.

standards.title: Packaged-Products weighing Over 150 lb (68 kg) utilizing Random Vibration
standards.scope_summary: Non-simulation integrity screening for individual packaged products weighing over 150 lb (68 kg), utilizing random vibration.
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: Used for large appliances during freight transportation.

standards.title: Packaged-Products weighing 150 lb (68 kg) or Less
standards.scope_summary: Partial-simulation test for individual packaged products weighing 150 lb (68 kg) or less when prepared for shipment.
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: Crucial for appliances distributed through humid or hot shipping lanes (e.g. Egypt / Middle East export routes).

standards.title: Packaged-Products weighing over 150 lb (68 kg)
standards.scope_summary: Partial-simulation test for individual packaged products weighing over 150 lb (68 kg) when prepared for shipment.
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: Evaluates heavy appliances subject to stack load in varying climates.

standards.title: Parcel Delivery System Shipments 150 lb (70 kg) or Less
standards.scope_summary: General simulation for individual packaged products prepared for parcel delivery by air or ground, within the procedure's published weight scope. It applies to standard, small, flat, and elongated packages.
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: Essential benchmark for e-commerce deliveries of appliances (Noon, Amazon, Jumia).

standards.title: Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) Shipment
standards.scope_summary: General simulation for packaged products commonly shipped through LTL, with packages from different shippers or for different destinations sharing a load.
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: Directly models regional distributor trucking from El Araby factories to retail branches.

standards.title: Similar Packaged-Products in Unitized Loads for Truckload Shipment
standards.scope_summary: General simulation for similar packaged products secured as unitized loads and shipped by full truckload, typically from manufacturing to a distribution center.
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: Directly matches NxtPak AI's Euro Pallet optimization calculations for stacked cartons.

standards.title: Extended Integrity Testing for Individual Packaged-Products weighing 150 lb (68 kg) or Less
standards.edition: Current procedure; confirm revision at source
standards.scope_summary: Extended non-simulation integrity procedure for individual packaged products within the published weight scope. It is a screening method and does not model a specific distribution environment.
standards.what_it_tests: Extended integrity of the product-package combination; use the current official procedure for its test elements and levels.
standards.when_it_applies: Individual prepared-for-shipment packaged products within the procedure's stated weight scope, when extended integrity screening is the objective.

standards.title: Distribution Center to Retail Outlet Shipment 100 lb (45 kg)
standards.edition: Current procedure; confirm revision at source
standards.scope_summary: General simulation for an individual packaged product in a mixed regional pallet shipment, typically from a distribution center to a retail outlet, within the published weight scope.
standards.what_it_tests: Package-product performance under a general simulation of the described regional distribution environment; consult the current procedure for specific elements and levels.
standards.when_it_applies: Individual packaged products sent as part of a mixed pallet from a distribution center to a retail outlet, within the published weight limit.

standards.title: Mechanically Handled Bulk Transport Containers
standards.scope_summary: General simulation for bulk loads in a transport container or system that require mechanical handling because of their size or weight; the load may be one product or a mixed load.
standards.what_it_tests: Bulk transport-system performance under handling, vibration, shock, and related transport stresses; no test levels are reproduced here.
standards.when_it_applies: Large or heavy bulk transport systems handled mechanically, including reusable transport racks where relevant.

standards.title: Ships in Own Container (SIOC) for Amazon Distribution System
standards.scope_summary: Member performance test for vendor-prepared products sent to Amazon fulfillment centers and onward to customers by parcel or LTL without additional Amazon packaging or preparation.
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: High-value cost and material reduction standard; achieving SIOC eliminates secondary boxes and prep chargebacks.

standards.title: Packaged-Products for Amazon.com Distribution System Shipment in OverBox
standards.scope_summary: Tests individual items packed inside master cartons or Amazon overboxes with air pillows or paper dunnage.
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: Applicable for fragile small components or multipacks sold through online retail.
